status: implemented; bit-identical to the stock path on Metal (kernel and full model, see validation); default OFF behind MLX2_MOE_NAX_GATHER (off|gather|fused; moe_nax_gather.set_mode for in-process A/B). Not qualified, not selected.

sources.source_pr: ddalcu/mlx-serve#638 (perf(moe): oMLX's segmented tensor-unit sorted gather_qmm, row map and fused SwiGLU), merged
sources.note: PR body read for the claim (+10.5% Flash-Next prefill, +2.6% gather alone) and the admission rule; no source read or copied (its Zig/Metal kernels pair separate gate and up arrays; mlx2 already holds one concatenated [gate; up] table).

modifications: Host gate: Metal available and an M5 device name (as qwen4_qsa_nax), plus the default device must be the GPU; every instantiation still proves nonzero numerics bitwise against mx.gather_qmm on a canary before use (oMLX's canaries, unchanged).

Policy: MLX2_MOE_NAX_GATHER (default off) replaces OMLX_M5_GATHER_QMM_NAX (default on); MLX2_MOE_NAX_GATHER_PLAN replaces OMLX_M5_GATHER_QMM_NAX_PLAN. The mx.gather_qmm monkeypatch is replaced by explicit calls from QuantizedSwitchLinear (plain gather, after mlx2's rhs pad) and FusedGateUpSwitchGLU (SwiGLU epilogue + row map).

Split-table pairing (mlx2): Flash-Next serves separate gate/up tables (MLX_QWEN4_MOE_FUSED_GATE_UP=0), so the paired TileLoader takes a gate and an up base pointer/quantization (oMLX's pair_row mapping, generalized), with its own canary against two stock sorted gathers + mlx2's compiled swiglu; sorted_gather_qmm_swiglu_split / try_swiglu_split, wired into FusedDownSwitchGLU. mlx-serve #638 also pairs separate arrays; its code was not read.
Admission counters (calls per route, fallbacks by reason, not-candidates) and status(); Flash-Next diagnostics carry them only when the mode is not off.

The GLM-5.3 clamped SwiGLU epilogue stays in the kernel template but is not wired; only exact mlx2 SwiGLU activations and exact QuantizedSwitchLinear tables (not the disk-streamed subclass) are admitted.
_sort_routes keeps mlx2's _gather_sort tail pad (n > 32768, n % 64) on the index and the row map, so x_tok[row_map] equals _gather_sort's rows exactly.
validation: GPU, M5 Max, mlx 0.32.2.dev20260919+39400a0d4, MLX_ENABLE_TF32=0, qualification/runs/port-nax-gather-20261002. (1) kernel.json: Flash-Next shapes (512 experts top-10, 2560->1280/2x640 and 640->2560), 4- and 8-bit g64, 512/2048/8192-token chunks: raw output bits identical to stock mx.gather_qmm(sorted) for gate_up, down, the concat and split SwiGLU epilogues with and without the row map; one-nibble falsifier differs; MoE layer 1.27-1.63x (gather) and 1.33-1.67x (fused) faster. (2) ab-served.json / ab-all4bit.json: 8192-token prompt, chunks 512/2048/8192, arms off/gather/fused: trunk hidden of all positions and last logits bit-identical on both artifacts; counters nonzero (fused: 48 gather + 48 split-map calls per 8192 chunk), 0 fallbacks. Prefill fused/off 1.204/1.089/1.063 (served) and 1.200/1.143/1.060 (all-4-bit), every on rep faster than every off rep. (3) 48 greedy tokens after a 923-token chat prompt identical across arms, last decode logits bit-identical, 0 NAX calls during decode. CPU: tests/test_moe_nax_gather.py 30 passed.
